lines: Your voice untangles me
My heart says it doesn't want to forget
The memories just keep piling up
I want to stay by your side forever
Is it okay if I'm a crybaby?
You don't have to act tough
Even if this love has its limits
I'm happy to have met you
Forever and ever
Forever and ever
I'm praying it goes on
Even if I can't take your hand
I love you
Your dreams put my heart at ease
I say I don't want to wake up
The memories just keep piling up
I want to be by your side tomorrow too
On and on
On and on
I want you to scold me for being so dense
I'm still a child who can't notice
when the everyday things start to break
But I truly do love you
If only my time could just stop
Look, I've gone and let myself hope again
I'll try to hold it all in
But if it spills over
Look me in the eyes — look, look, look at me
Only your shadow keeps stretching longer
Please don't disappear
This feeling will never change
Forever and ever
Forever and ever
I'm praying it goes on
Even if I can't take your hand
I'm held in the embrace of the passing present
If only my
time could just stop
Let me savor today
Don't end
Summer, don't end
